title: jmap: implement Email/changes and Mailbox/changes for incremental sync
description: Why: Without /changes methods, JMAP clients must re-query the full mailbox on every poll — O(n) per sync. Email/changes and Mailbox/changes (RFC 8621 §3.3, §4.6) enable O(delta) incremental sync. StateStore already exists in crates/mail/src/state/version.rs and tracks per-scope monotonic state integers. The infrastructure is in place; the methods are just missing. What: (1) Wire StateStore state into Email/get, Email/query, Mailbox/get, Mailbox/query responses (currently hardcoded '0'). (2) Implement handle_email_changes(account_id, since_state) — queries overview index for articles with state > since_state, returns {accountId, oldState, newState, created, updated, destroyed}. (3) Implement handle_mailbox_changes() — queries group list for groups added/removed since since_state. (4) Wire both into route_method().
